description: This file contains functions for extracting and validating plugin configuration settings, sections, and actions in a Mattermost web application, including handling React components and various setting types.

methods.name: extractPluginConfiguration
methods.description: Main function to extract plugin configuration object from unknown input, validating structure and components.

methods.name: extractPluginConfigurationAction
methods.description: Extracts and validates a plugin configuration action object.

methods.name: extractPluginConfigurationSection
methods.description: Extracts and validates a plugin configuration section, including component validation.

methods.name: extractPluginConfigurationSetting
methods.description: Extracts and validates individual plugin configuration settings, including radio and custom types.

methods.name: extractPluginConfigurationCustomSetting
methods.description: Validates and extracts custom plugin configuration settings with React components.

methods.name: extractPluginConfigurationRadioSetting
methods.description: Validates and extracts radio button plugin configuration settings.
